description: This file defines a templated interface for an iterator type within the WPEFramework RPC namespace. It declares the IIteratorType class, which provides methods for iterating over a collection of elements, including Next, Previous, Reset, IsValid, Count, and Current. The interface is designed to be inherited by other classes that implement specific iterator behaviors.

classes.name: IIteratorType
classes.description: A templated interface defining iterator operations for a collection of elements, with a specific interface ID and element type, inheriting from Core::IUnknown.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next element and outputs the element via reference.

methods.name: Previous
methods.description: Moves the iterator to the previous element and outputs the element via reference.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the iterator's position to the specified index.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Returns whether the current iterator position is valid.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the total number of elements in the collection.

methods.name: Current
methods.description: Returns the current element at the iterator's position.
